name: Rotting Eden
source:
A mysterious entity looms above the city, releasing a strange red dust that slowly infects anyone exposed to it. As the government enforces a citywide quarantine, your girlfriend, Eden, begins showing symptoms of a mysterious condition known as Blooming.

The authorities tell you to report the infected.

Instead...

You hide her. 

[From [url=https://belawgames.itch.io/rotting-eden-demo]itch.io[/url]]
